summary: POMDOCTOR Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release highlighting its four-tier diversified revenue structure, including B2C healthcare services, AI-enabled chronic disease subscriptions, B2B services, and pharmaceutical real-world data services. The filing discloses fiscal 2025 net revenues of approximately RMB399.9 million (US$59.04 million) versus RMB342.6 million in 2024. It is a routine business update with no transaction, shareholder action, or special-situation event. No deal terms, advisors, or premium are stated. Watch for operational execution on AI and subscription growth, but no risk-arb angle exists.
